top3.headline: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
top3.whyItMatters: Leadership at AI's key chip supplier is settled, and the White House says Trump was involved.

top3.headline: Walmart lets Meta's Muse agent buy Black Friday deals for shoppers
top3.whyItMatters: Agent shopping is live at a top retailer; your checkout will need to serve agents too.

top3.headline: DeepMind's Gemini 4 agent teams build cheaper quantum circuits
top3.whyItMatters: Agent teams now produce research results, which puts R&D among the jobs to redesign.

items.title: DeepMind's Gemini 4 agent teams build cheaper quantum circuits
items.takeaway: Google DeepMind says teams of Gemini 4 agents built quantum circuits that cut future simulation costs by up to 10 times.
items.soWhat: Multi-agent setups are moving from code into research work.

items.title: Ray Dalio: radical transparency removes hidden agendas from decisions
items.takeaway: Ray Dalio argues radical truthfulness and transparency, plus thoughtful disagreement, make an idea meritocracy.
items.soWhat: He says open disagreement, not hidden agendas, is how the best idea wins.

items.title: a16z: in an OpenAI collaboration, 2,000 agents mined eight million cells
items.takeaway: a16z says OpenAI is building tools for scientists; 2,000 agents found patterns months of human analysis missed. OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio.
items.soWhat: OpenAI is moving into science tooling, where agent scale replaces months of manual analysis.

items.title: Rauch had Fable study his sessions; it picked Gemini Neon over Opus
items.takeaway: Guillermo Rauch asked Fable to study his coding sessions and choose between Opus and Gemini Neon. It picked Neon.
items.soWhat: Let an agent judge models on your own work, not public benchmarks.

items.title: Benaich flags UK inquiry into its compute and data-centre strategy
items.takeaway: Nathan Benaich shares a UK Committee inquiry on whether the UK can capture value in an AI economy dominated by US firms.
items.soWhat: Countries outside the US are asking how to keep value from AI they don't build.

items.title: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.takeaway: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang, announced Monday. The White House says Trump was 'totally involved'.
items.soWhat: The main AI chip supplier's leadership question is settled for now.

items.title: Walmart lets Meta's Muse agent buy Black Friday deals for shoppers
items.takeaway: Walmart is rolling out a live agent gateway: Meta's Muse can find and buy deals through Walmart's Sparky assistant.
items.soWhat: Retailers are opening checkout to outside agents; plan how agents will buy from you.

items.title: Meng To shares a 19-minute tutorial for a Fable 5.2 game
items.takeaway: Meng To published a 19-minute video on building a game with Fable 5.2, with all the skills he used.
items.soWhat: Published skills and video make the workflow copyable by your own design team.

items.title: Rauch: aim AI at making hard ideas understandable to humans
items.takeaway: Guillermo Rauch argues a Riemann proof from AI should come with a paper, a walkthrough and new concepts people can grasp.
items.soWhat: Judge AI output by whether your people can follow it, not just whether it works.

items.title: Paper proposes privilege separation for grading coding-agent benchmarks
items.takeaway: arXiv paper 'Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks', submitted Nov 20.
items.soWhat: Ask whether an agent could reach its own grader before trusting a benchmark score.

image.alt: arXiv cs.AI: Paper proposes privilege separation for grading coding-agent benchmarks

items.title: llm-gemini 0.38.1: only Neon and Hydrogen get xhigh reasoning
items.takeaway: Simon Willison's llm-gemini 0.38.1: Gemini 4 Carbon supports low, medium and high reasoning; Hydrogen and Neon add xhigh.
items.soWhat: Check which Gemini 4 tier allows the effort level your agents need.
